## rhnerv_comma_mgrid

**Submission name:** `rhnerv_comma_mgrid` (matches `submissions/rhnerv_comma_mgrid/`)

**archive.zip (177,080 bytes):**
https://github.com/flowmar47/comma_video_compression_challenge/releases/download/rhnerv-comma-mgrid-v1/archive.zip
SHA-256 `e82f97e5f5569b504e8efa0fc2ba5fd57ed2735a65be83b7025007c53a5e9d79` — `curl -L` verified.

**report.txt:**
```
=== Evaluation results over 600 samples ===
  Average PoseNet Distortion: 0.00002943
  Average SegNet Distortion: 0.00056023
  Submission file size: 177,080 bytes
  Original uncompressed size: 37,545,489 bytes
  Compression Rate: 0.00471641
  Final score: 100*segnet_dist + √(10*posenet_dist) + 25*rate = 0.19
```
Full precision: 100·0.00056023 + √(10·0.00002943) + 25·0.00471641 = **0.191088** (beats PR #112 rhnerv_comma: 0.191126 by −0.000037).

**Does your submission require GPU for evaluation (inflation)?** No — decode is pinned to CPU, ~3 minutes on 4 cores.

**Did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?** Yes — `compress.sh` rebuilds `archive.zip` byte-for-byte from the SHA-pinned PR #101/#110 release archives (deterministic, no training).

**Is this submission competitive or innovative? explain why** Competitive: the decoded video is **byte-identical to PR #112/#110** — same SegNet/PoseNet distortions to all printed decimals — with the payload losslessly re-coded for an additional **−56 bytes** vs the current #1:

| Change | Section | Bytes saved |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| `M_GRID` add `4096.0` | decoder | −4 |
| `LATENT_ADAPT_M` `480 → 1440` | latents | −4 |
| `MAX_CROSS` `4 → 5` | latents | −4 |
| container header v2 (implicit decoder length) | header | −2 |
| `SHARED_MODEL_TENSORS` expand | decoder | −18 |
| Markov selector (`selector_markov.py`) | selector | −24 |
| **Total vs PR #112** | | **−56** |

No new training; distortion unchanged by construction.

**Lineage and attribution** (see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`): decoder weights/latents/sidecar from PR #101 (@SajayR), selector + inflate chain from PR #110 (@adpena), architecture from PR #95 (@AaronLeslie138, MIT), channel biases from PR #98 (@EthanYangTW). This is a pure entropy-coding delta on their work.

### 60-second repro
```bash
git clone https://github.com/commaai/comma_video_compression_challenge && cd comma_video_compression_challenge
git lfs pull && uv sync --group cpu
curl -L -o submissions/rhnerv_comma_mgrid/archive.zip \
  https://github.com/flowmar47/comma_video_compression_challenge/releases/download/rhnerv-comma-mgrid-v1/archive.zip
uv run --group cpu bash evaluate.sh --device cpu --submission-dir ./submissions/rhnerv_comma_mgrid
```
